about_the_game:
Play the first bit of Bru & Boegie: EPISODE 1 - Get da MILK!

  • Get a generous feel for Bru & Boegie's world!

  • Save games will be carried over to the full game if you have Steam Cloud Sync enabled, carry on from where you leave off!

  • Steam Achievements unlocked during the demo will be rewarded when you first run the full game, just make sure Steam Cloud Sync is enabled so Steam grabs your save files from the ethereal cloud.
